title: TestSIGTERMToALiveRunEvacuatesItsWorkToTheRemote fails at base: the SIGTERM exit leaves a temp tree behind
description:
internal/cli/evacuate_signal_test.go:213 reports 'the SIGTERM exit left its temp trees behind: [ticfac-registry-guard-<n>]' — reproduced 3/3 at the base a999d400 in a scratch worktree before any of my commits, and 2/2 on my finished branch, so it is not vqc's (my change is SIGINT-only and does not touch the tempdir/evacuation path). It is an end-to-end test (skipped under -short), so `make gate` is green while `make test`/CI is red at base. The leftover name suggests the registry guard's temp root (learnings: 7ag, registrytest.GuardMain) is not being released on the SIGTERM exit path.

ticfac run epic-2jn filed this backlog tick from the finding 24e62946a4dc19540519d42a88d42c67230727b6d8dc9234b39da420d41c1940 (reported by run-epic-2jn/tick-vqc/attempt-50): the done is reachable with the finding standing, so it is a backlog tick with an owner rather than the epic's to absorb. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-2jn/absorptions/24e62946a4dc19540519d42a88d42c67230727b6d8dc9234b39da420d41c1940.json on the run branch.
